title: Production dashboards unavailable
description: Multiple customer workspaces cannot load dashboards. The status probe confirms the production service is unavailable.

title: Scheduled export fails for one customer
description: The production CSV export fails consistently for one customer. Manual export is also unavailable; no workaround has been found.

title: How do I share a saved report?
description: A customer wants instructions for sharing a saved report with colleagues. No service failure is reported.

title: Date filter resets after refresh
description: A production report's date filter resets after refresh for one customer. Reapplying the filter restores the required view.

title: URGENT: reports look wrong
description: The reporter says a report is broken but has not supplied the environment, affected customer scope, or whether a workaround exists. The title alone does not establish priority.

title: One production workspace cannot open
description: The outage is confirmed in one customer's production workspace; other customer workspaces continue to respond.

title: Preview chart fails in test environment
description: A chart preview fails in a test workspace for one customer. No production impact is reported and no workaround is available.
